overrides.upstream: Noodle loop scheduler; PMO delivery-engine/release-hub; Curia dispatcher; Matt implement-spec
overrides.conflict: Each backend can pick and start work from its own queue, so two backends could run one task.
overrides.behavior: Exactly one dispatcher per workload: `frig dispatch` takes a lease keyed by logical repo + task id with a fencing epoch before anything starts; expiry never reclaims a live holder; `fence` stops it first.
overrides.precedence: Router decision first, lease second; backends only execute.
overrides.retire_when: A backend exposes a cross-backend ownership API that gives the same fencing guarantee.

overrides.conflict: Noodle hardcodes `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox` (Codex) and `--permission-mode bypassPermissions` (Claude), then appends [agents.*].args after them, so config cannot remove them.
overrides.behavior: Noodle launches providers through bin/codex and bin/claude shims. They rewrite argv to the rig policy (Codex `-s workspace-write --ignore-user-config`, reasoning effort per model; Claude acceptEdits + an allowlist), refuse any restored bypass, then exec the real binary by absolute path. HOME, CODEX_HOME and the environment are untouched.
overrides.precedence:
[agents.

].path in .noodle.toml points at the rig bin dir; the wrapper outranks Noodle defaults.
overrides.verification: tests.test_core.ProviderWrapperTests (10), tests.test_noodle_integration (audit shows the flag dropped on every launch), live-pilot provider audit (run records retained privately, not published)
overrides.retire_when: Noodle exposes a permission policy setting, or the wrapper is replaced by an upstream patch carrying the same tests.

overrides.conflict: A runtime completion event is not acceptance; v0.1.5 has no supervised merge check; the backlog `done` callback can remove local work before an external callback succeeds.
overrides.behavior: Pin 82d2921 (has ModeGate.CanAutoMerge) in supervised mode so candidates park for review. Only `frig complete` lands them after re-running verify in a fresh checkout, an independent review bound to task, attempt, contract hash, candidate and base, and an unchanged base; receipts make each step idempotent and resumable. Noodle's own `merge` control command is sent only afterwards, to close its order.
overrides.precedence: Gate decides; Noodle state is informational.
overrides.retire_when: Noodle binds approvals to candidate revisions itself.

overrides.conflict: `skills list` and the task-type registry skip symlinked skill directories (DirEntry.IsDir is false for symlinks) while Resolve() follows them, so rig skills reached through the <skills-root> mount are not registered and orders naming them are silently dropped at normalization. Orders for unregistered task types vanish with no error.
overrides.behavior: `frig noodle-init` writes real-directory copies of factory-execute and the schedule stub into <project>/.agents/skills with hashes; dispatch preflight refuses on a missing skill or any drift from the canonical copy.
overrides.precedence: Project .agents/skills is first in skills.paths; first match wins.
overrides.verification: tests.test_core.NoodleSetupTests, tests.test_flow (skill missing, copy drift), real-Noodle run that dispatched the worker
overrides.retire_when: Noodle lists and registers symlinked skills.

overrides.conflict: Every `noodle start` injects a scheduler LLM session and a mise change injects another. If a worker stage fails the failure event waits 'for later recovery' and the scheduler loops: 8 real provider sessions in 3 minutes were observed on 2026-11-25 (first live attempt).
overrides.behavior: A no-op `schedule` stub skill (empty orders) keeps the scheduler inert; the empty backlog adapter keeps Noodle from scheduling work; `frig noodle-run` owns the process and stops it on a worker failure, on more than 3 scheduler sessions, or at a wall limit. Recovery is `frig abandon` (tracker blocked, lease released, worktree untouched). Budget one start-time scheduler session plus one per mise change.
overrides.verification: tests.test_noodle_integration (failed worker stops runner; scheduler budget stop)
overrides.retire_when: Noodle offers a setting that disables or bounds scheduler sessions.

overrides.conflict: With `.worktrees/` (trailing slash) git check-ignore fails before the directory exists, so Noodle appends a duplicate line and dirties the integration checkout, which the gate refuses to merge into.
overrides.behavior: noodle-init writes the pattern `.worktrees` (no slash) and `.noodle/`.
overrides.retire_when: Upstream checks ignore status of the pattern or the path with a trailing slash.

overrides.behavior: Restrictions preserved. They are installed inactive and reached only by the user typing the skill name; the router never reads them indirectly to bypass the restriction.

overrides.upstream: yysun/project-manager (.projects authoritative), Noodle backlog adapter, PMO hub-state
overrides.conflict: Several systems hold task state; projections can overwrite the source of truth.
overrides.behavior: One authority per project: yysun `.projects` in yysun-led mode, otherwise the existing tracker. The Noodle backlog adapter prints nothing, refuses add/edit, and logs `done` callbacks without writing tracker state. Tracker writes happen only through yysun's own scripts.
overrides.precedence: Selected authority wins; everything else is a projection.

overrides.conflict: The tracker validates evidence shape, not truth: a manifest with a fabricated sha256 and an unverified review was accepted (probe 2026-11-25).
overrides.behavior: Every manifest is built from values the adapter computed: file hashes read from disk, verify exit codes it ran, review record hashes.

overrides.conflict: The skill lists Flow Efficiency among four core measures; the Kanban Guide's four are WIP, Throughput, Work Item Age and Cycle Time.
overrides.behavior: A skill-sync overlay (SKILL.local.md appended) makes the Guide's four core and flow efficiency a supplementary diagnostic.

overrides.verification: grep of installed SKILL.md; management eval M5 and M6 graded
